name: FormTray index
description: An index of twelve captures of FormTray's own windows: filter them, hover a line to preview the capture, open one to read about it.

summary.label: Intro
summary.default: FormTray is a launcher and switching station for the 23 FormAI apps: five views on system glass, in dark and light. Hover a line to preview the capture, open one to read about it.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Stack: a small grid of the Form apps that are open, each with its icon and name, and an All Apps tile, floating over a purple and blue desktop

children.name: Description
children.text: The Stack shows the Form apps that are open right now, in launch order, with a Quit button on each. FormTray in place of the Dock, for the family only.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Apps view in the dark appearance: a search field, category buttons, a Recent row and a grid of every Form app

children.name: Description
children.text: A searchable panel with categories, recents and every released app in one place. Pins, recents and running dots agree with every other view.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Switcher: a horizontal strip of nine Form app icons with the second one selected and its name underneath

children.name: Description
children.text: A Cmd+Tab-style strip. Hold the modifier and tap to move along it. The view appears the instant the hotkey is pressed.

attrs.alt: FormTray Settings in the light appearance: Opens with, Open at login, and a list of apps with Show and In menu bar switches

children.name: Description
children.text: Settings in the light appearance. Each app can be set to show in the menu bar, and every hotkey can be rebound. Preferences live in JSON files under the OS config folder.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Windows view titled Open Form apps: three cards, each with an icon, a running time and buttons to bring it forward or quit it

children.name: Description
children.text: One card per open app, with how long it has run, a button to bring it forward and one to quit it.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Widgets board in the dark appearance: app tiles in several sizes and a FormPortal tile

children.name: Description
children.text: The board you arrange: tiles, groups and a FormPortal Updates tile. The Dock icon opens the view you last chose, and Widgets is the default.

children.name: Value
children.text: Opens by default from the Dock

attrs.alt: The FormTray Widgets board with large, medium and small app tiles arranged in rows over a dark panel

children.name: Description
children.text: App tiles in three sizes, groups that open as a pop-over, and a FormPortal Updates tile that reads FormPortal's files and never fetches.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Switcher in the light appearance: a pale strip of nine Form app icons with the first one selected

children.name: Description
children.text: The Switcher in the light appearance. The icon pack comes in dark and light and follows the system appearance.

attrs.alt: FormTray Settings in the dark appearance: Opens with, Open at login, and a list of apps with Show and In menu bar switches

children.name: Description
children.text: Click a hotkey and press a new chord. FormTray refuses a chord the system or another FormTray action already uses, and Default puts the original back.

children.name: Value
children.text: Click a hotkey, press a chord

attrs.alt: The FormTray Apps view in the light appearance: a search field, category buttons, a Recent row and a grid of every Form app

children.name: Description
children.text: The Apps view in the light appearance: a search field, categories, recents and every app in one panel.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Switcher in the dark appearance: a dark strip of nine Form app icons with the first one selected

children.name: Description
children.text: The Switcher in the dark appearance. Defaults avoid each system's reserved chords, and the strip needs no network because FormTray never touches one.

attrs.alt: The FormTray Widgets board in the light appearance: app tiles in several sizes and a FormPortal tile on a pale panel

children.name: Description
children.text: The Widgets board in the light appearance. Tiles come in three sizes and groups open as a pop-over.
